law_texts: the hook never makes the agent wait, except for your answer.
the core does no i/o except reading transcripts.
a check's result is its last run's.
nothing on the main thread takes the notices' lock.
the window's types and the rust wire types agree.
a session's pieces are written one at a time, in order.
a stored file of an older format still loads.
a change is untrusted text: the writer has no tools.
delete never ends a terminal another live session uses.
colour is only for what needs you.
